privacy.title: Privacy and Cookies Policy
privacy.html:
Sarveda Life Pvt. Ltd. insists upon the highest standards for securing transactions and protecting your Personal Information and privacy. Please read the following statement to learn about our information gathering and dissemination practices. Our privacy policy is subject to change at any time without notice. To make sure you are aware of any changes, please review this policy periodically. Sarveda Life is committed to protecting and safeguarding your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes the types of personal information collected on the Sarveda Life website, how we mutually benefit from such information, how we may use that information, and with whom we may share the same. The Privacy Policy also describes the measures we take to protect this information's security and how you can access, modify, or delete your personal information at any time. It also explains how you can object to your personal information processing or to receiving communications about our products and services. By mere use of the website, you expressly consent to our use and disclosure of your personal information per this Privacy Policy. If you disagree, please do not use or access our site. This Privacy Policy is incorporated into and subjects to the following Terms and Conditions

1. Collection of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) And Other Information

Sarveda Life limits itself to collect information to ensure accurate service. Most of the information we collect is essential and is needed to complete a purchase or provide a refund. Examples of customer information that we may collect include your name, address, telephone number, date of birth, email address, descriptions of the items requested or purchased, language preference, the IP address and operating system of your computer, and the browser type and version being used by you. We will not sell, distribute, or lease your personal information to third parties. We may automatically track certain information about you based upon your behavior on our site. We use this information to do internal research on our users' demographics, interests, and behavior to understand better, protect and serve our users. This information is compiled and analyzed on an aggregated basis. This information may include the URL you just came from (whether this URL is on our site or not), which URL you next go to (whether this URL is on our site or not), your computer browser information, and your IP address.
  • Credit Card, Debit Card and Banking Information
    Sarveda Life does not collect or store Credit Card or Debit Card or any of your banking information. It is directly transmitted through the payment gateway provider to the payment network or bank.

2. Registration

To take advantage of some site features, you must register and create a free member account. An online registration form may require you to provide information such as your name, email address, and password. Your password is a component of our security system. As such, it is your responsibility to protect it. Do not share your password with any third parties. If your password has been compromised for any reason, you should change it immediately.

3. Technologies that Allow Us to Customize Your Experience on Sarveda Life

We use various technologies to collect information relating to your visit to our website. These include Uniform Resource Locator (URL) that referred you to our Website, Internet Protocol address, browser type, browser language, the date and time of your request. These technologies enable us to enhance and customize your experience on our website. For example, we may collect the Internet Protocol (IP) to identify your computer or device and indicate your geographic region for statistical purposes. In some instances, we may use these technologies combined with the personally identifiable information you provide on the website. These technologies may provide a variety of information, such as whether you have visited Sarveda Life before. They also may enable you to save your preferences. Each technology is explained below.
  • Web Beacons and Tracking Links
    Web Beacons (also called clear gifs and pixel tags), tracking links, and/or similar technology consist of a few code lines embedded on our website's pages. They are often used in combination with Cookies and are usually not visible to the website's user. Web Beacons may relay information to third parties such as our service providers. They may track customer response to certain advertising, target interactive advertising better, and enhance customer support and usability. If you reject our Cookies (see the Cookie section below), you will prevent Web Beacons from relaying this information about you and may limit your use of some of our Website features.
  • Cookies
    We use data collection devices such as "cookies" on certain websites to help analyze our web page flow, measure promotional effectiveness, and promote trust and safety. "Cookies" are small files placed on your hard drive that assist us in providing our services. We offer certain features that are only available using a "cookie." We also use cookies to allow you to enter your password less frequently during a session. Cookies can also help us provide information that is targeted to your interests. Most cookies are "session cookies," meaning that they are automatically deleted from your hard drive at the end of a session. You are always free to decline our cookies if your browser permits, although in that case, you may not be able to use certain features on the website, and you may be required to reenter your password more frequently during a session.

4. Use of Your Personal Information, Demographic, and Profile Data

We use personal information to provide the services you request. To the extent we use your personal information to market to you, we will offer you the ability to opt out of such uses. We may use your personal information to resolve disputes; troubleshoot problems; help promote a safe service; collect money; measure consumer interest in our products and services, inform you about online and offline offers, products, services, and updates. Also, customize your experience; detect and protect us against error, fraud, and other criminal activity; enforce our terms and conditions; and as otherwise described to you at the time of collection. In our efforts to continually improve our product and service offerings, we collect and analyze demographic and profile data about our users' activity on our website. We identify and use your IP address to help diagnose our server's problems and administer our website. Your IP address is also used to help identify you and to gather broad demographic information. We will occasionally ask you to complete optional online surveys. These surveys may ask you for contact information and demographic information (like zip code, age, or income level). We use this data to tailor your experience to provide you with content that we think you might be interested in and display the content according to your preferences.

5. How Do We Mutually Benefit from Personal Information?

  • Marketing Emails
    Suppose you choose to leave your email address with us. In that case, we will deliver information to you through emails such as our newsletters, surveys, or other email messages containing product and event information, cosmetics tips, or promotions. Suppose at any time you decide that you would not like to receive these emails. In that case, you may select the 'Unsubscribe' link on the email or edit your information and consent to receive email and other communication in the 'Profile' section for registered users.
  • Text Messages
    If you have chosen to leave your mobile phone number with us, you may receive text message/SMS alerts containing product and event information, cosmetics tips, or promotions on your mobile phone. Please note that we will never send you any unsolicited text messages on your mobile phone. Sarveda Life does not charge any fee for you to receive any text message from us. However, your mobile service provider may charge you for sending and/or receiving text messages and airtime, as well as any other standard applicable rates charged by your mobile service provider.
  • Telephone Calls
    Suppose you have chosen to leave your mobile phone number or landline number on our website. In that case, you may receive phone calls containing product and event information, cosmetics tips, or promotions on your mobile phone or landline phone.
  • Communications to Serve You
    Suppose you have chosen to provide us with your contact information. In that case, we may provide you with service-related announcements by any means, including email, letters and concerning the website, or contact you regarding your customer service requests or questions. For example, all registered users will receive a welcoming email to confirm their registration. These types of communications are necessary to serve you, respond to your concerns, and provide the high level of customer service that Sarveda Life offers its customers.
  • Customized Service
    We may use your personal information you have chosen to provide you with customized service and use of our website. For example, we may suggest products that would be of particular interest to you. Such customized information may be conveyed to you through emails or text messages/SMS and phone calls.
  • Special Events, Questionnaires, And Surveys
    On occasion, Sarveda Life may sponsor special events (such as contests, promotions, or other offerings), questionnaires, and surveys. There may be specific rules applicable to these promotions that explain how any personal information you provide will be processed. We strongly suggest you review any applicable rules before participating. To the extent any special event, questionnaire, or survey is not subject to specific regulations, this Privacy Policy governs the processing of personal information and the purposes it sets forth.
  • Employment
    Suppose you provide personal information to us for employment, such as your resume. In that case, we will treat such personal data as confidential and use it only to consider you for current and future employment opportunities and contact you regarding employment with us or our affiliates. We will retain your information for further recruitment opportunities that may arise unless you tell us that you no longer wish to maintain your information. An "Affiliate" is a person or entity directly or indirectly through one or more intermediaries, controls or is controlled by, or is under common control with, our company.

6. Advertisements on Sarveda Life

We use third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit our website. These companies may use information (not including your name, address, email address, or telephone number) about your visits to this and other websites to provide advertisements about goods and services of interest to you. We do not take any responsibility for your visits to such other websites and provide any information/s therein.

7. Links to Other Sites

Occasionally, we may make available a link to a third-party website. These links will let you leave the portal. The linked sites are not under our control, and we are not responsible for the privacy practices or the contents of any linked site or any link contained in a linked site or any changes or updates to such sites. We are not responsible for webcasting or any other form of transmission received from any linked site. We provide the links to you only as a convenience. We do not endorse the site or its use or contents.

8. Sharing of Personal Information

We may share personal information with our other corporate entities and affiliates. Who may use the said information to detect and prevent identity theft, fraud, and other potentially illegal acts and correlate related or multiple accounts to avoid our services' abuse? Also, to facilitate joint or co-branded services, where such services are provided by more than one corporate entity. If you have any objection to such sharing, we invite you to provide us with any information. The information sharing is as per the policy defined here. We may retain other companies and individuals to perform functions on our behalf consistent with this Privacy Policy. Examples include website management companies, order processing companies, courier companies, data analysis firms, customer support specialists, email vendors, web-hosting companies, and fulfillment companies (e.g., companies that coordinate mailings). Such third parties may be provided with access to personal information needed to perform their functions. Still, they may not use such information other than on our behalf and per this Privacy Policy. In some instances, you may be offered the opportunity to consent to share your information with a third party, such as an event or promotion co-sponsor. If you consent, we will share your information with such a third party, and such third parties may use the information you provide for their purposes and per their policies. We may disclose personal information if required to do so by law or in the good faith belief that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to respond to any court orders or other legal process. We may disclose personal information to law enforcement offices, third party rights owners, or others in the good faith belief that such disclosure is reasonably necessary to: enforce our Terms or Privacy Policy; respond to claims that an advertisement, posting, or other content violates the rights of a third party; or protect the rights, property or personal safety of our users or the public.

9. Business Transfer

We and our affiliates will share/sell some or all of your personal information with another business entity should we (or our assets) plan to merge with or be acquired by that business entity. Should such a transaction occur that another business entity (or the new combined entity) will be required to follow this privacy policy for your personal information?

10. Security Precautions

We have put in place reasonable measures to protect the personal information contained in our databases. Steps are in place to prevent unauthorized access and maintain appropriate use and accuracy. Furthermore, data transmitted in association with our online store is encrypted and secured by SSL as per international standard IS/ISO/IEC 27001. Does your retention agency have IS/ISO/IEC 27001 certificate?

11. Transfer of Data to Other Countries

Sarveda Life, the Affiliates, and third parties may receive your personal information per this Privacy Policy. The databases in which your personal information is stored shall be located in India and are required to honor the privacy representations made in this Privacy Policy under applicable laws of this country. In case of data transfer to any other country, legal protections applicable to personal information in the concerned country will apply.

12. Choice/Opt-Out

We provide all users with the opportunity to opt-out of receiving non-essential (promotional, marketing-related) communications from us on behalf of our partners and from us in general after setting up an account. If you want to remove your contact information from all Sarveda Life lists and newsletters, please visit: https://www.sarvedalife.com/unsubscribe.php

13. Policy Change

Our Privacy Policy may change from time to time. We will not reduce your rights under this Privacy Policy without your explicit consent. We will post any privacy policy changes on this page. If the changes are significant, we will provide a more prominent notice (including, for certain services, email notification of privacy policy changes). We will also keep prior versions of this Privacy Policy in an archive for your review.

14. Your Comments

We welcome your feedback. If you have questions or comments about our privacy policies, feel free to drop us a message by writing to us at care@sarveda.com.

15. Our Rights

We may elect to monitor areas of the portal electronically and may disclose any Content, records, or electronic communication of any kind (a) to satisfy any law, regulation, or government request; (b) if such disclosure is necessary or appropriate to operate the portal; or (c) to protect our rights or property or the rights of the users, Sponsors, Providers, Licensors, or Merchants. We are not responsible for screening, policing, editing, or monitoring such content. If notified of allegedly infringing, defamatory, damaging, illegal, or offensive content, we may investigate the allegation and determine in our sole discretion whether to remove or request the removal of such content from the portal. We may terminate or suspend your access to all or part of the site without any notice to you. This termination will be done as and when, in our sole discretion, we feel that your conduct on the website is in violation of any applicable law or is harmful to the user's interests, a third-party Provider, Merchant, Sponsor, Licensor, service provider, or us. Because customer service is paramount to our business, we reserve the right to refuse to sell products to you if it reasonably appears to us that you intend to resell the products. Also, we reserve the right to limit quantities of items purchased by each customer.

16. Your Consent

Using the website and/ or providing your information, you consent to collecting and using the information you disclose on the website per this Privacy Policy, including but not limited to Your consent for sharing your information as per this privacy policy. If you believe that any information we are holding on to you is incorrect or incomplete, please write to or email us as soon as possible at the above address. We will promptly correct any information found to be incorrect. Worldwide Copyright © Sarveda Life Pvt. Ltd. (brand owners Sarveda Life). All worldwide rights reserved.

refunds.title: Returns, Replacements & Refund Policy
refunds.html:
At Sarveda, we take great care in crafting and dispatching our products. However, if you experience an issue, we are here to assist you under the following terms: 1. For wrong, damaged, or broken items, Provide a video showing the unopened package, shipping label, and the complete unboxing, so the issue is immediately visible. Submit clear videos or photos that clearly show the issue, making it easily identifiable. • The product must be returned in proper packaging to avoid further damage during reverse transit. • Reverse pickup will be arranged through our authorized logistics partner, where applicable. Failure to provide adequate proof may result in rejection of the claim.
2. Damaged Product (Transit Damage) If the product is damaged during shipping, you will receive a full refund within 7 working days of its arrival at the warehouse. No extra fees apply.
3. Quality Issues (No Transit Damage) If there is no physical damage, but you believe there is a quality issue: • Clear proof must be submitted, including: • Videos/photos clearly showing the issue • For musical instruments, tuning videos, or demonstrable evidence of the concern • The claim will be vetted by our quality team. If approved, your refund or replacement will be processed within 7 working days of receipt at the warehouse. • Shipping charges may be deducted depending on the nature of the case.
4. Wrong Product Delivered If you receive an incorrect product, an unboxing video is required. A full refund or replacement will be provided within seven working days of warehouse receipt, with no shipping or pickup charges.
5. Change of Mind (Return or Exchange) For a change of mind, the product must be unused and in its original packaging. Refunds are processed within seven working days of receipt, minus shipping and pickup costs. For exchanges, extra payment must be completed before dispatch.
6. Refund Processing Timeline Eligible refunds are initiated within seven working days of receipt and inspection. The refund will be processed through UPI ID / Phone number. The timing of the reflection in your account depends on your bank.

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.html:
